title: Storage Tenant Terms: Added Retention Share on Parking Rent Increases
content:
A tenant who also rents storage from the company under a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement receives a bundle share on a retention concession under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement. The bundle share is added to the share of the increase given back, and the combined share is applied once to the increase:

| Tenant's storage unit records | Bundle share added |
|---|---|
| An active storage unit rental moved into at least 24 months before the handling date | 5 percentage points |
| An active storage unit rental moved into more recently | 2.5 percentage points |
| No active storage unit rental | nothing |

The records read are the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement status (active) and move-in date; months are whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month, and exactly 24 months qualifies for the 5-point figure.

Hypothetical illustration: where the share of an increase given back is 50% and the tenant's active storage unit was moved into 40 months ago, the combined share is 55%; on a $14.00 increase that is $7.70 given back, before any limit on the amount given back. With a unit moved into 11 months ago the combined share is 52.5%, which is $7.35 on the same increase.
